permanent_product_target_reference: See next_live_session_plan.md and this task's PERMANENT PRODUCT TARGET section for the full ticker-decision-contract (horizon/decision/status enums etc.) that this notification layer is built to eventually surface.

notification_classes.SYSTEM: startup, preflight, session-readiness state, stale data, broker errors, kill switch, status heartbeat -- operational health, never a trading signal
notification_classes.PREMARKET_RADAR: PREMARKET_WATCH / PREMARKET_WATCH_CLEARED -- observational only, see premarket_radar_contract.json. NEVER alpha evidence, NEVER an order.
notification_classes.NATURAL_SIGNAL: a real QuantScanner-published SIGNAL, source=STRATEGY -- the only class that represents actual strategy output
notification_classes.PAPER_EXECUTION: order/fill/position lifecycle events with source=STRATEGY -- real (paper) broker activity driven by a NATURAL_SIGNAL
notification_classes.PIV_TEST: anything with source=PIV_LIFECYCLE_PROBE -- operational lifecycle-proof traffic, alpha_evidence=false always, structurally excluded from strategy statistics
notification_classes.EOD: EOD_FLATTEN, SESSION_SUMMARY, EOD_SUMMARY -- end-of-day reconciliation and rollup

classification_mechanism: talonx_piv.events.notification_class_for(event, source) is a pure function; EventBus.emit() auto-stamps PivEvent.notification_class if the caller didn't set one explicitly. EventBus.format_telegram() prefixes every Telegram line with '[CLASS]' so an operator can visually separate a NATURAL_SIGNAL from a PIV_TEST or PREMARKET_RADAR line at a glance.

spam_avoidance.existing_mechanism_reused: EventBus._key()-based dedup (event+correlation_id+broker_order_id+status+reason) already suppresses a repeated identical event from reaching Telegram twice -- unchanged, reused as-is.
spam_avoidance.premarket_radar_specific: PremarketRadarEngine only emits a transition (new WATCH, bias change, or WATCH clearing) per symbol -- an unchanged bias produces zero further notifications no matter how many radar ticks run.
spam_avoidance.heartbeat_specific: STATUS_HEARTBEAT is rate-limited to at most once per HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS (1800s / 30min) AND is suppressed entirely if a NATURAL SIGNAL published more recently than that interval -- see session_runner.py's _maybe_emit_heartbeat.

cadence_by_session_phase.premarket: startup/mode/provider/universe/warmup status at start; PREMARKET_WATCH/CLEARED only on transition; no per-tick chatter
cadence_by_session_phase.regular_session: ACTIONABLE (NATURAL_SIGNAL) immediately; STATUS_HEARTBEAT only if no natural signal for >=30min ('No actionable trades. Engine active.' plus decision-ready symbol count, evaluation cycles, candidates, top rejection reason)
cadence_by_session_phase.eod: EOD_SUMMARY via build_session_report's natural_strategy/piv_test_traffic split, reconciliation, quant_funnel

watch_safety_invariants.watch_is_not_alpha_evidence: PREMARKET_WATCH events always carry alpha_evidence=false and notification_class=PREMARKET_RADAR -- reporting.py never folds them into natural_strategy counts
watch_safety_invariants.watch_cannot_place_an_order: structural, not just behavioral -- talonx_piv/premarket_radar.py imports neither talonx_piv.broker nor talonx_piv.lifecycle at all (enforced by tests/test_task69q_evidence_upgrade.py::test_premarket_radar_module_never_imports_broker_or_lifecycle, an AST-level import check)

longer_term_multi_day_horizon.status: contract/category retained (PivEvent.horizon field, NATURAL_STRATEGY_HORIZON constant), but NOT emitted -- no MULTI_DAY strategy has been researched/frozen/validated. decision_engine.py hardcodes horizon=INTRADAY_SHORT for every natural QuantScanner-driven event; nothing in this task manufactures a MULTI_DAY signal or WATCH.

general_app_backward_compatibility: Every change described here is additive and read through optional fields (notification_class, piv_info dict) that default to None/absent for the general (non-PIV) run_talonx.py application -- see tests/test_task69q_evidence_upgrade.py::test_pipeline_status_general_app_behavior_unchanged_when_no_piv_info.
